recipes.title: Drawn bass line
recipes.intent: A bass voice built from a computed single cycle (control points, no audio): per-register shapes, plucked with the decay control.
recipes.code:
setcpm(100/4)
$: note("e1 e1 g1 a1 e1 d2 b1 g1").s("wt_drawn_bass").attack(0.004).decay(0.5).sustain(0).release(0.1).hpf(25).lpf(1400).gain(0.83)

recipes.title: Drawn choir pad
recipes.intent: A vowel-morphing pad from three computed keyframes (ah, oh, oo) with the wavetable position moving over the chord loop. A stand-in, not a choir recording.

recipes.title: Drawn drum kit (computed)
recipes.intent: Kick, snare, closed and open hat, clap and tom from the computed drum models; four seeded variants of each (s("dr_kick:2")). Electronic drum voices, not an acoustic kit.
recipes.code:
setcpm(110/4)
$: s("dr_kick:0 ~ [~ dr_kick:2] ~, ~ dr_snare:1 ~ dr_snare:2, ~ ~ dr_clap:0 ~").gain(0.56)
$: s("dr_hat_closed*8").n("<0 1 2 3>").gain(0.34)
$: s("~ ~ ~ dr_hat_open:1, ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ dr_tom:3").gain(0.44)

recipes.title: Drawn electric guitar chords
recipes.intent: Power chords from a computed bright cycle with distortion. A stand-in tuned for distorted playing; clean parts are thin.

recipes.title: Drawn viola and cello
recipes.intent: A viola line over a cello line from computed cycles with vibrato and a slow bow attack. Bowed-string stand-ins that read as synth strings; the cello is fairer in its low register.
recipes.code:
setcpm(72/4)
$: note("<c4 e4 g4 e4>").s("wt_drawn_viola").attack(0.12).release(0.4).vib(5.5).vibmod(0.3).lpf(4000).gain(0.5)
$: note("<c2 g1 a1 f1>").s("wt_drawn_cello").attack(0.16).release(0.5).vib(5).vibmod(0.3).gain(0.6)

recipes.title: Drawn steel guitar pluck (computed)
recipes.intent: A plucked-string line from the Karplus-Strong model: per-note tables from c2 to c4, repitched between. No bends or slides: a stand-in.
recipes.code:
setcpm(90/4)
$: note("<[c3 e3 g3 c4] [a2 c3 e3 a3] [f2 a2 c3 f3] [g2 b2 d3 g3]>").s("dr_steel_guitar").gain(0.6)

recipes.title: Drawn FM percussion
recipes.intent: Clave, bell and conga from the two-operator FM model, four seeded variants each.
recipes.code:
setcpm(105/4)
$: s("dr_fm_clave:0*2 dr_fm_clave:1 dr_fm_clave:2").gain(0.66)
$: s("~ dr_fm_conga:0 dr_fm_conga:1 ~, dr_fm_bell:0 ~ ~ dr_fm_bell:2").gain(0.66)

recipes.title: Drawn hall space on the kit
recipes.intent: The drawn-core `room-hall` preset (synthetic space: Strudel's algorithmic reverb, no recorded impulse response) on a kick and clap loop.
